verdict.rationale: Cake documents the separate pieces of this story: option grants with NSO/ISO support and an options contract editor, automated board sign-off and e-signing flows on its stock options page, and a 409A valuation included in the cap table plan and delivered within 3 business days. The evidence never shows these pieces joined into one workflow where the 409A value sets the strike price inside the grant and approval flow, and all of it is marketing-level vendor copy. missing for 10: documented linkage of 409A fair market value to strike price within the grant flow, step-by-step evidence of an end-to-end hire-to-grant workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
